investigation.baseline: CSP intake computes (current + 1) % 200 and makes two KV writes per report. Summary treats the ring index as a count, reads slot 0000 on first report, and reports zero on wrap. Today account analytics reports 224 writes; no current outage claimed.

items.title: Bound CSP diagnostics independently of sign-in KV and preserve truthful summaries
items.why: A public diagnostic stream can exhaust shared sign-in KV writes, while modulo counters hide actual stored violations.
items.userOutcome: Members retain sign-in write allowance; operators can find accurate retained diagnostic counts and distinguish unavailable evidence.
items.recipe: Replace the unbounded CSP KV ring writer with private R2 diagnostic batches using the existing isolated TT_REPORTS binding and a separate existing SQLite counter (three stored batches per hour). Bound actual streamed bodies to 16 KiB. Preserve legacy three-day evidence, repair ring-wrap/first-slot summary errors, read new objects with complete bounded pagination, and return unavailable rather than a false zero on incomplete storage. Retain CSP objects for three days. Verify concurrent intake, quota/storage faults, legacy ring boundaries, summary pagination, exact staging and production storage round trips. Keep CSP enforcement, headers and identity policy intact. Also bound public summary computations globally with a distinct existing SQLite object, at most three per fixed hourly window; reject denied, missing or failed admission before storage reads with unavailable/null. Verify real transactional concurrency/reset, isolated staging admission/denial and production readback. Failed computations consume admission; inbound requests/counter calls remain outside this cap.

executionLog.note: S388 isolates Content Security Policy (CSP) diagnostics from sign-in KV writes. Intake uses private R2 batches with a separate existing SQLite counter, at most three stored batches/hour and five reports/batch, with an actual streamed 16 KiB body bound. Summary counts actual retained legacy ring records and complete current object records over three UTC dates; storage faults return unavailable, never a clean zero. The advisory probe requires explicit completeness. Three-day csp/raw/ and existing 30-day tt/raw/ retention are verified in both private buckets. Focused Worker/CSP tests86/86, probe17/17 and lifecycle8/8 pass; broad unit suite452 passed/0 failed/1 existing TODO. Independent review passed after one probe-state fix. Full local, exact staging, hosted checks and production acceptance remain pending in docs/RELEASE_S388.json.
